findings: THERE IS NO MAIN QUEST. 37 quests on disk: 21 side, 11 faction, 1 hidden, 4 tagged category=main but all act 2 magic-utility fillers (Q-BLAK-01, Q-MAG-05/13/19). RI-QST06 needs 28 main quests across 5 acts + 3 backpath.

Quest runtime IS wired: game/src/engine.js:236-238 constructs QuestBook, FactionGates, QuestEngine from this.data.quests. Harness verbs exist at game/src/harness/api.js:757-778 and 848: questOffers/questOpen/questNote/questResolutions/questResolve/questFail/questSetFlag/questBook/questEventsDrain/questReveal/questLearnTopic.

HARD CONSTRAINT: QuestEngine constructor (machine.js ~line 98) THROWS if any quest id in the book lacks an entry_topics row in hooks.json (RI-DLG05 A.3). Every new main quest MUST get an entry_topics entry or the game does not boot.

QuestBook._check() is fail-loud: directions >=20 chars mandatory, journal indices ascend/unique/banded (rumour 1-9, accepted 10, progress 11-39, post_reveal 40-69, failure 70-89, success 90-99, closed 100), no imperative-verb journal openers, prohibitions.js banned prose scan, one distinct success index per resolution, branch targets must resolve, requires_knowing must name a declared reveal, symmetric exclusivity.

Settlements (game/data/world/pois.json): stormhold[2171,761] thorn[3820,859] gideon[439,2913] helstrom[2262,2773] archon[3785,3823] blackrose[1905,4450] soulrest[610,4877] lilmoth[2766,5027]. 13 regions in game/data/world/regions.json.

DESIGN: main quest = The Rootward Tide is failing (RI-LOR05 §6 cause C is authorially true). Handler Undersexton Aveline Rell, Drowned Court, Soulrest. Mandate = the ninth clause of the Ninth Recension of the Drowned Tally (D7, never_revealed). Antagonist = Ixtu-Meer, the Steward of the Count, tending a pre-Duskfall xanmeer reservoir under the Stone Wastes. Endings: open the Count / keep the Count / backpath cut. Acts I-V = 5/5/5/8/5, +3 backpath = 31 quests, ids Q-MAIN-01..31.

deceit.revealed_by is the ONLY place a reveal id may be declared. requires_knowing and branch.leads_to both resolve against it, so ANY quest with a knowledge gate needs a deceit block even when the giver is honest (patterns D10/D12 fit an honest quest).

CONFLICT: Q-BLAK-01, Q-MAG-05, Q-MAG-13, Q-MAG-19 carry category:"main", act:2, stakes 8-9. They are magic-utility quests mislabelled by tools/analysis/gen-magic-quests.mjs (cat:"main" shorthand). They already break RI-QST06 (Act II stakes band is 3-4) and they inflate the Act II count to 9 against a 5±1 target. magic-audit Q11_WEIGHT is 9 against a >=6 bar, so reclassifying up to 3 of them is safe.

mainline-census PASSES all RI-QST06 checks incl. 5 hard fails: acts 5/5/5/8/5, stakes 2.40/3.60/7.60/8.50/10.00 strictly increasing, Act IV simultaneous off Q-MAIN-15 alone, 7 of 8 rank-leveraged, mean res 3.375, D7 x4 all never_revealed, 0 rank_gate, backpath present, PONR fraction 0.9643.

RI-QST09 side effects of adding 32 quests: X1 24.3->56.5 PASS, X2 9->13 PASS, X7 0->62 (regression I introduced) fixed back to 0 by giving every exclusive resolution its own npc_disposition entity, its own reward and >=3 distinct flags, X8 0->76.92 (bar 80) - the 9 remaining unforeshadowed exclusive quests are ALL pre-existing non-mainline (Q-ARCH-01, Q-SOUL-02, Q-BLAK-01, Q-STRM-01, Q-LILM-01, Q-SAP-01, Q-LEDG-01, Q-DOCK-01, Q-DEEP-01); 30 of 30 mainline exclusive quests foreshadow. Fixing the other nine is W1-18 prose and I did not edit another builder's journal text.

TRACE GREEN: intended chain 29/29 quests completed, 158 journal entries, 0 violent resolutions, PONR crossed, ending_the_count_was_opened. Backpath chain 17/17, 95 entries, 0 violent, ending_the_count_went_past_the_roots. 121 world flags differ between the two ending states. Zero markers, zero duplicate stage entries, 100% dated, 100% first person.

CONSUMPTION DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED (the eighth in this project): the per-NPC `disposition` field is authored on every record in game/data/npcs/** and NOTHING in the build read it. game/src/sim/quest/gate.js canOffer() checks giver.disposition_min against sim.quest.dispositions, which started empty and was only ever written by a Charm effect (sim/magic/apply.js) or by a quest consequence, so EVERY quest in the build with disposition_min > 0 was unofferable from a cold start. Engine.seedDispositions() now copies it at boot and on every reset/loadState. Perturbation proof: the drop-dispo sabotage zeroes the table and Q-MAIN-01 refuses to open with "undersexton-aveline-rell disposition 0/25".
Sabotage controls all go red: drop-topic stops at Q-MAIN-01 (topic gate), drop-reveal stops at Q-MAIN-06 (requires_knowing gate), drop-dispo stops at Q-MAIN-01 (disposition gate).
